selection_policy: two diagnostic checks only; no further configuration search or release choice
limitations: Automatic publisher targets are not independent lexical WER gold.
Human dev subset is small, previously inspected and includes unresolved digit spelling.
Whole VOICI original is dev-only; mixtures share ONE noise group, not independent flights.
Noise has publisher speech-removal provenance, no independent human verification.
General clean controls were already observed; regression only, no tuning or selection.
No human event/salience/entity or continuous temporal labels are created.
B noise microphones/channels are correlated; conservative grouping by aircraft, only two groups.
Flight noise has publisher provenance, no independent human speech-absence audit.
FLEURS is general read Russian, no speaker identifiers, one conservative group, no cabin claim.
Impulse responses validated as data, not used to simulate independent recordings.
Language-effect comparison deliberately changes input information and is not same-information pipeline evidence.
Small versus large changes checkpoint; it cannot establish same-checkpoint pipeline improvement.
English is a saved human declaration; French and mixed language are never inferred from a desired transcript.
Memory sampling is device-wide on a shared GPU, not exact per-process GPU allocation or guaranteed peak.
All data are already exposed dev/diagnostic cohorts, not independent final test.
